Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Charcoal Distressed Medallion Area Rug, 8 x 10 Foot
Colors: Charcoal
Materials: synthetic
Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported Drawing inspiration from traditional Persian textiles, this design bursts with a bright, all-over medallion pattern. Durable, machine-woven synthetic fibers keep this rug looking fresh and feeling soft to the touch, even in high-traffic spaces. Area rug features a bright medallion pattern Machine-woven with 100% polypropylene fibers Low .2'' pile suits low- to high-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 8' x 10' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
